fusions.name: Death Roll
fusions.desc: A gripping weapon strike that deals 14 damage, stuns the target for 1.4 seconds, and makes it [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Closing Jaws
fusions.desc: A crushing bite that deals 30 damage and leaves the target 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 5% of their maximum health.

fusions.name: Still Water
fusions.desc: Veils you for 8 seconds. Enemies notice you far later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Coiled Wait
fusions.desc: The moment your stamina is full, your physical damage rises by 25% for 5 seconds. Once every 15 seconds.
